verdict.rationale: Datalab exposes a well-documented public REST API plus a Python SDK and CLI, with detailed endpoints for convert/extract/segment/pipelines, checkpointing, webhooks, and cost tracking, and runtime probes confirm the API is live and auth-gated and the SDK/CLI installs and runs keylessly. missing for 10: no discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (all candidate paths 404), and no independent third-party developer testimonial specifically about API integration quality.
